headline: Pennsylvania: new authority over AI or data centers for a government body
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would give the Department of Health, Insurance Department, and Department of Human Services the power to regulate artificial intelligence use by facilities, insurers, and MA or CHIP plans. Not passed.

169 measures in 40 jurisdictions would require a label, watermark, or disclosure on AI content, or a notice to the people AI is used on.

29 measures in 11 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is coming for the jobs.

2,239 measures tracked. 754 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
